name: Forced displacement
summary: IOM: Sudan's displaced total barely rose in October; Yemen tops 340,000 since August; no event over 500,000 a month
state: IOM said Sudan's internally displaced population was about 8.59 million in October, up less than 1% on September, with rises in Blue Nile and Khartoum (Dabanga via AllAfrica, 17 Nov). IOM said on 13 Nov that more than 340,000 people had been displaced by fighting in western Yemen, mainly in Taiz, Lahj and Al Hodeidah, over several months (APA). Neither amounts to a new event displacing 500,000 in a month, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: No new mass displacement event is under way. Travellers to Sudan and Yemen should follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: No new event displacing >500,000 in a month = Normal
